# Snowcraft Reforged

> A free, browser-based remake of the classic 1998 Snowcraft snowball-fight game, built with Phaser 3. Click and hold to charge a throw, release to launch a snowball in a physics-based arc, and defeat the opposing green team across five progressively harder levels.

Snowcraft Reforged is an open, HTML5 game that runs entirely in the browser — no install, no account, no ads. It preserves the original 1998 sprite art and sound while adding 2.5D snowball physics (gravity, arc, shadows), a modern scaling AI, and three difficulty settings.

## Key facts

- **Name**: Snowcraft Reforged
- **Genre**: Action / Arcade / Casual snowball-fight game
- **Platform**: Web browser (HTML5 canvas, desktop)
- **Engine**: Phaser 3.60
- **Price**: Free (no ads, no signup, no in-app purchases)
- **Author**: ChiefInnovator
- **Source**: https://github.com/ChiefInnovator/snowcraftai
- **Play online**: https://chiefinnovator.github.io/snowcraftai/
- **Levels**: 5 progressive levels
- **Difficulty settings**: Easy, Normal, Hard
- **Native resolution**: 600x320 (scalable up to 1800x960)
- **Inspired by**: Snowcraft (1998)

## How to play

1. Click and hold on a red team player to select them and begin charging throw power.
2. A power meter fills while held — longer holds produce faster, longer-range throws.
3. Release the mouse button to launch a snowball in an arc toward the green team.
4. Defeat every green team player to clear the level and advance.
5. Beat all five levels to win. The green team throws back, so keep moving.

## Gameplay mechanics

- **Snowball speed formula**: `speed = 0.012 + (strength / 100) * 0.006`
- **Player strength range**: 1–100 (held-charge controlled)
- **Enemy strength range**: 50–90 (randomized per throw)
- **Player max speed**: ~0.0180 (strength 100)
- **Enemy max speed**: ~0.0174 (strength 90)
- Players have a wider range than enemies, enabling both short lobs and long snipes.
- Enemies are more consistent — they never throw truly weak shots.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Snowcraft Reforged?** A free browser remake of the 1998 Snowcraft snowball-fight game, built with Phaser 3.

**Is it free?** Yes — completely free, no account, no ads, no purchases.

**Do I need to install anything?** No. It runs in any modern desktop browser.

**How many levels are there?** Five, each harder than the last.

**What browsers work?** Any modern browser with HTML5 canvas — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.
